Behind the pool spans a giant curved LED backdrop screen, complemented by an angled triangular screen on the right. Audience members sit casually in front and to the sides. World text: '白鲸科普展示' on the backdrop screen; 'Health Care Session' on the side screen. Media played: Live PA voice commentary broadcast over the arena sound system.
